title: Efficient Large Displacement/Large Rotation Dynamic Simulations Using Nonlinear Dynamic Substructures
summary: Utilizing reduced-order dynamic math models (DMM) in linear system-level dynamic analyses is a well-known practice that enables extreme computational efficiencies. But what about nonlinear system dynamics? Reduced-order DMMs have found their way into contact dynamics. The engineer must look no further than the Henkel-Mar pad separation analysis methodology…
